_note: pip install pystk2-gymnasium (brings pysupertuxkart2). Uses its supertuxkart/full-v0 gym env; the 3D scene is grabbed from the in-process race, so it needs a REAL GL context (a display or Xvfb+GLX) and does NOT work under SDL_VIDEODRIVER=dummy.
_keys_note: PassthroughKeySpec: curriculum 'keys' whitelist the physical keys forwarded into the race (values are identity; the action is the held set, which step() turns into the env's Dict action: accelerate/brake/steer/fire/drift/nitro). Keep the message Controls text in sync with 'keys' by hand.
